# Alviva

> Alviva is an AI-powered calorie tracker app. Users scan meals with their camera to instantly get calorie and macronutrient breakdowns, receive personalized nutrition goals from AI, and track daily progress with smart reminders and health insights.

Alviva helps people build better eating habits by making nutrition tracking fast and effortless — no manual food logging required. The AI analyzes food photos, estimates calories and macros, and adapts recommendations to each user's lifestyle and goals.
